title: trust.json acknowledgements sub-document
description: PROPOSAL (RFC #7809) — not published. Bulk acknowledgements referenced from trust.json acknowledgements_url, for organizations (e.g. ad networks and SSPs) that accept thousands of grants. Kept off the signature-verification fetch path. Every entry follows the trust.json acknowledgement rules: agent_url MUST be an agents[] entry in the referencing trust.json, and terms come only from the grantor's document. Removing an entry withdraws the acknowledgement; verifiers SHOULD apply the grant source's retention rules (for adcp:adagents, the revoked-publisher-domain retention) before treating a removal as permanent.

next.description: Optional same-host URL of the next shard. Verifiers follow shards in order and stop at a configured limit.
